rows.body: Cmd-K palette would be huge. I lose ~10 minutes a day clicking around the toolbar.
Can we get keyboard shortcuts for bold/italic? The mouse round-trip is painful for long docs.
Love the product but onboarding was confusing — couldn't tell which tier I was on for my first three days.
I almost churned on day two because the empty state didn't tell me what to do first. A guided tour would have helped.
Three of my teammates didn't know we had a paid plan. The free-tier banner is too subtle.
Inline collaboration would push this to a 10. Right now we paste links into Slack and lose context.
We export to Google Docs whenever two people need to edit at once. That's a workflow break we live with.
Comments + @mentions would unblock a real pain. We're tracking review feedback in a separate doc.
SSO via Okta is a hard requirement for our IT team. Without it we can't roll out past the pilot.
We're stuck because the security review can't approve a tool without SAML. We've been waiting six weeks.
Nice product, but the mobile experience is unusable. I can read but not edit on my phone.
Tried to edit a doc on iPad during a flight — half the toolbar buttons don't render.
Finding a doc I wrote three months ago is hopeless. Search returns titles only and the title is rarely what I'd remember.
Full-text search would save me ~15 min/day. Currently I scroll through the sidebar.
Best note app I've tried. One ask: dark mode that actually respects system theme.
Dark mode toggle exists but doesn't sync with macOS auto-switch. Eye strain in the morning.
Exporting to PDF mangles tables. We end up screenshotting the doc, which is silly.
Can the markdown export preserve nested checkboxes? They flatten on the way out.
I love how fast the app feels. But the onboarding video auto-plays with sound — got me in trouble in a meeting.
First-run checklist would help. I poked around for 20 minutes before I found the templates section.
